nom: Pixi BeautifEYE Brightening Eye Patches with Vitamin C

avis.texte: Was excited to try these, I put them in the fridge over night so theyd be nice and cool in the morning. They have a weird smell to them and burned my undereyes so i took them off relatively quick
I tried these twice, both times they burned and irritated my undereyes. At first i thought it was just my skin getting used to the ingredients but thats definitely not it as it kept happening.

just bought it and tried it for the first time, left them on for 10 minutes, and i can honestly see a brighter more awake difference already. i put it in the fridge so next time im going to use it chilled and see how that works and feels as well. so far ill give it a thumbs up!
I love these little eye masks, they're inexpensive and work great. I keep them in my refrigerator and apply daily. I struggle with puffiness and dark circles.

I really like this prouduct pop them in the fridge for a longer cooling time when you apply it feels so relaxing ! Started seeing results after 2 weeks of doing it every other day ! Love them & the smell isnt bad !

I really like this prouduct pop them in the fridge for a longer cooling time when you apply it feels so relaxing ! Started seeing results after 2 weeks of doing it every other day ! Love them & the smell isnt bad !
Loved this product, help with my under eye bags and made me feel refreshed and awake

avis.titre: Good but only purchase when on sale or w/ coupon
avis.texte: Love these but I would only get them when they go on sale or when I have a coupon. They are hydrating and feel good on my under eyes.
so good and cooling for thenundereye, can keep on for an hour+ and still get the same effects as I had just put it on
I've applied these multiple times in hopes it would help with my under eye bags, but unfortunately, it didn't do a darn thing.
I absolutely love these eye patches they woke up my under eyes, after a few uses i could see a differene underneath my eyes i do recommend this!!

This year, I started using eye masks to help with the bags under my eyes. I'm 38, so my condition was fair to start. These have been my favorite to use by far! You can tell they are infused with great product and they leave my skin feeling cool and refreshed! 10/10 recommend :)

My favorite Vitmain C eye masks got discontinued, so I went into my local Ulta and asked for a new rcommendation and these were the ones. They are at a great price point and I am very impressed! They are not too gooey/sticky and right out of the packaging are cool and soothing! They feel so good on my face and I love them in my routine!
These are my first eye patches I've used, and I really like them. My undereyes are brighter, tighter, and radiant. Perfect for the morning or whenever you begin your day

I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin, some products make my skin burn so bad its blood red or actually bleeds. With these, I do get a slight burn feeling but it's not painful where I feel they cant be used at all. That said, the patches are amazing, I'm starting to see my dark circles lightening and it has only been 3 days.
I couldn't recommend these enough. I love them so much and I've definitely seen a difference in my under eyes. RUN!!
I have very sensitive skin and it burned my under eyes. I was still able to see a difference but the burning isnt enjoyable. Im looking for something more soothing for sensitive skin.
These eye patches soothe my eyes after showering before I apply makeup, and I just started wearing them to bed, which helps reduce puffiness in the morning.

They're definitely fun to use. I think they make a slight difference on my dark circles. That said, sometimes they sting a little and make me slightly red, which could be due to my retinol use and the combo of them. So keep that in mind.

so usually I don't use products right away because I have a stock pile. That being said, once I started using these I continued each day. I put them on every morning and I swear the patches smoothed my under eyes out. I wore them for at least an hour. The cool feeling felt great and took my under eye bag swelling down plus like I said my wrinkles smoothed out. I am actually ordering another today. I never had a problem with them drying out in the container or drying my under eyes.

I saw these patches in an IG post and ordered them. They're a total game changer. I'm 49 and have been struggling with dryness/concealer issues and these patches have done wonders. I paired it with Bye Bye It Concealer and have never been happier :)
have added these to my nighttime routine and am loving the extra hydration my skin gets, especially during the summer. definitely keep them in the fridge!
I think they work well and definitely make my eyes brighter. I have sensitve skin and they didnt hurt my eyes at all. The only problem is that they dry my eyes.

These certainly made my undereyes brighter! But, they dried out over time, and I had to invert the container before I used them each time to soak them in serum. Sometimes when I used them, they burned during application, but there was no visible irritation + they still worked!
I was super excited to try these out /: I just feel they made no difference under my eyes and they're just too pricy for the quality …

These are a must for dark circles! I have a special event today, so I bought these yesterday. I tried them on last night and today and I noticed a big difference! I did not think they would work so quickly! I have A LOT of trouble sleeping, so my eyes are very dark, but these brighten my under eyes so good for just trying them on two times! I will definitely be using them for now on! My fiance tried them on, but he has sensitive skin and it started to burn and cause redness right away, so probably not good for those with sensitive skin.
These aren't bad, but if you are dry or sensitive it burns! I think I will try the detoxify instead, hopefully that won't burn!
I was skeptical! But when one pad slipped off I could see the difference, less puffy and less dark. Feels nice, soaks in well, doesn't irritate eyes or skin.
I absolutely love this product im a college student that gets maybe 4 hours of sleep a night so my dark circles are horrid but these eye patches help me so much < 3
I never thought I had super sensitive skin, but i used for 4 days in a row & my skin has been burning & puffy ever since (2-3 days later). Also, I haven't seen improvement in my dark circles.

avis.titre: Fun to use, but dark circles are still there
avis.texte: It's fun to give myself a spa day using these eye masks, but they don't visibly brighten the under eyes. If you have them and struggle to keep them from sliding off, I recommend positioning the outside part higher up on your face. Once most of the serum absorbs into the skin, the remaining product may make your skin feel tight (which is a good and bad thing depending on the person).

I love these. These patches make my under-eye feel so good. If I changed one thing on them, it would be the cuts for the eyes. These patches are made for people who have round eyes. I cut mine every morning to fit my shape better. Suggestion maybe add a few cuts, similar to a face mask, so they or more flexible to any eye shape.

An influencer recommended this as a dupe to Peter Roth's eye patches so of course I decided to try. The fit under the eye is not great and you don't notice a difference in hydration or brightness after using the product. Would not but again.
I definitely see a difference after use these a few times! I love them and will definitely be purchasing more.

I have sensitive skin, this burns under my eyes . also its very slippery. They literally fall down my face . I wanted to like these so badly I've heard really great things. But after resetting them 3 times and when its time to take them off my skin just burns .

I have naturally darker skin under my eyes, but lately due to stress and weird sleep theyve been looking WORSE! I look tired all the time! I just used these for the first time and there is an incredible noticeable difference. I will 1000% be adding the use of these eye masks to my nightly skincare routine.

avis.titre: Very gentle on my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I really like it and i do believe it makes a difference. the only tricky part is the fact that i have to wait a bit before putting it on because it would slide all over my face. other than that it's grand

As a full time college student with a busy home life, I've been struggling with dark circles under my eyes. Since using these, the bags under my eyes have completely disappeared. I leave them on for about an hour or two while I finish any last minute assignments before going to bed. When I take them off the skin under my looks amazing!!!
I wanted to love these but they're not worth the cost. Slimy and hard to keep the jar clean and they dry out very quickly.

I bought these last year and was using them weekly. I loved them BUT I also wasn't wearing makeup then and not touching my face. After a while, I noticed the product never would soak in my skin and would just peel off…. Definitely do not recommend as a prep before makeup. My makeup would look terrible.
This mask is so relaxing against that it makes me feel so refresh after wearing them. But my only problem is that there is no tool to smooth down the mask without using my fingers

I got those for a deal so I decided to buy it. The gel pads are pretty sturdy so i wouldn't worry about ripping them while putting them on. I keep them in my cold bathroom and the feel of putting them on while doing a face mask or after I shower and wash my face is a great cooling feeling. Plus, my under eyes are very soft right now.

I tried using these once a week with a facemask but they quickly dried out and are thick and gooey. They smell like chemicals and although the cooling effect feels nice, I don't think they've done anything for my under eye area. Would not recommend.
Leaves my eyes feeling good I chill them before putting on and I've noticed a difference
I love Pixi products and have been using them for two years now. I recently added this product to my routine and I'm in love .

avis.titre: I think I'm allergic to these but still use them
avis.texte: I really don't know if these do anything but I like the way they feel and look on

I tried these as I was using another more expensive brand these have now replaced those and are definitely worth the price. definately a noticeable difference in puffiness and brightens around the eyes. my new eye mask hands down.
I absolutely love these! The cooling on your eyes is so nice and after a week I'm starting to see a difference with the bags under my eyes. Thank you.
Feels nice to have them on but not sure if they actually do anything. Also the serum seemed to gather at the bottom after the first week so now the top ones are dry. Wouldn't recommend.

Cooling and refreshing. Moisture to under eye area. Great to keep in fridge and boosts the cooling effect. To aid in depuff. Tap in excess serum after removing pads. As far as brightening, not 100% sure. But feels nice when self pampering with a mask. 30 sets, so pretty good value for price.
I just got mine and I already in love. Just one question, do I put the eye patches on before or after applying moisturisers and SPF?
After using these masks, and I've used almost the whole container, my eyes are noticeably less dark and puffy and feel very moisturized. As a mom of two, they have helped me tremendously. Love!!
I have only used these twice bit can not believe the difference they have made to my puffy under eyes I keep them in the fridge and there so cooling when you put them on love them.

These are so so so so good you must buy them. I don't usually do reviews but these are so amazing that I had to. You get so many patches for your money and they are so pretty you feel like a guru when you scoop the patches out of the container.
I am so pleased with this product it works for me yaaaaay. Dont wase your money on expensive products like I have as this is the best I have used. Thank you thank you x
i dont write reviews usually but these eye patches were so amazing i had to. i have 2 kids and lack of sleep. These patches did wonders. My dark circles were vanished!
I have very dark circles since I can't sleep very good.. But since I use this product they are less dark!
This is best products i have ever used for my dark cicrlce undereyes
